## My takeaways
1. SI consensus: peak Legends Luke (FotJ) beats DE Sidious, Plagueis and Valkorion in most posters' view. This matches my tier list (Luke is top of tier 5, i.e. under Sidious) only if Luke is placed at LotF level; FotJ Luke (unread by me) is higher. Keep my verdicts on LotF-era Luke (primary-read) and flag FotJ Luke separately.
2. ROTJ Luke is far lower (loses to Revan). Era labels matter.
3. Gaps: FotJ unread (primary); no SI Luke vs Krayt / Luke vs Abeloth one-on-one thread; WollfMyth209 NJO/New Republic/Rebellion RTs unread.
